name: Vácszentlászló (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and green in the ratio 1:1:1 with a serrated fly edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vácszentlászló (a blue shield with a yellow horse and ears of grain on a green mound) above a scroll inscribed VÁCSZENTLÁSZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
